channel.title: Sielo — Official Releases & Updates
channel.description: Official release announcements and features for Sielo, the tactile, lossless Android music player.

item.title: Sielo v11.6.0 Released — Orbit Collaborative Listening & Infinite Playlist Imports
item.description: Sielo 11.6.0 is now live with Orbit collaborative rooms, seamless infinite multi-page Spotify playlist imports (100, 320+ tracks), YouTube/YT Music playlist imports, stutter-free drag-and-drop reordering, vibe-aware dynamic queue, and harmonic animated progress bars.

item.title: Sielo v11.5.6 Released — Lossless 320k Audio & Synced Lyrics
item.description: Sielo 11.5.6 brings tactile vinyl controls, millisecond-accurate LRCLIB synced lyrics, Vibe Radar discovery, and dual-stream 320kbps CD-quality audio playback.
